location: apps/web/src/providers/motion-provider.tsx:1-20; apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx:80; 12 of 15 framer-motion files (e.g. components/ui/bookmark-button.tsx, components/layout/mega-menu.tsx, components/review/FlashCard.tsx, components/stories/InteractiveStory.tsx, components/games/SymbolMemoryGame.tsx, components/oracle/OracleChat.tsx) have no reduced-motion handling
problem: No <MotionConfig reducedMotion="user"> exists (grep for MotionConfig = 0 hits) and only 3 files call useReducedMotion; the CSS rule at globals.css:948 cannot stop framer's JS-driven transforms.
impact: Readers with prefers-reduced-motion still get flip cards, menu and story transitions, contradicting .impeccable.md ('prefers-reduced-motion collapses cinematic to static') and the accessibility statement.
fix: Wrap the tree in MotionProvider with <MotionConfig reducedMotion="user"> so transform and layout animations are skipped site-wide; keep per-file useReducedMotion where opacity-only fallbacks are wanted.
verification: Emulate prefers-reduced-motion: reduce in Playwright, open /review, mega-menu, a story; confirm no transform animation runs (getAnimations().length === 0).

location: 31 occurrences of outline-none in apps/web/src, e.g. components/ui/button.tsx:8, components/ui/tabs.tsx:31, components/ui/card.tsx:14, components/ui/select.tsx:162, components/entities/FilterToolbar.tsx:94, components/layout/mobile-nav.tsx:91; no forced-colors rule anywhere in globals.css
problem: Focus styles are ring (box-shadow) with outline removed. In Tailwind v4 outline-none sets outline-style:none (v3 left a transparent outline); the old behaviour is outline-hidden. In Windows forced-colors mode box-shadow is dropped, so focus is invisible.
impact: Keyboard users in High Contrast mode lose the focus indicator on buttons, tabs, cards, selects, menus (WCAG 2.4.7 / 2.4.11).
fix: Replace outline-none with outline-hidden where a ring replaces it (shadcn primitives first), or add @media (forced-colors: active) { :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid CanvasText } } in globals.css.
verification: Chromium with emulated forced-colors: active, Tab through header, a tab list and an EntityCard; each focused element shows a visible outline.

problem: The pronunciation (IPA, Listen audio button, Copy IPA) lives only inside a Radix HoverCard opened by a <button> trigger with cursor-help.
impact: Radix HoverCard does not open on touch, so phone users (390px crawl viewport) cannot play the pronunciation; for keyboard users the portaled content is not in tab order after the trigger, so Listen is hard to reach.
fix: Use a Popover (click/tap and Enter/Space toggle) or inline the Listen button next to the phonetic text; keep the hover behaviour as an enhancement only.
verification: At 390px tap the [ZYOOS] button on /deities/zeus: the panel opens and Listen is reachable by Tab.

location: apps/web/src/components/timeline/TimelineVisualizationD3.tsx:109-113,581 (min 600px tall, touch-none, d3.zoom at :231-239); apps/web/src/components/atlas/AetherMap.tsx:165 (h-[min(76vh,46rem)]) with OrbitControls at components/atlas/AetherScene.tsx:260-268
problem: Full-width visualizations capture touch drags and wheel scroll with no modifier or escape: the timeline SVG is at least 600px of touch-action:none, the atlas canvas is 76vh of OrbitControls, and hint copy says 'Drag to orbit · scroll to zoom' (AetherMap.tsx:239).
impact: On a phone a vertical swipe starting inside the chart cannot scroll the page (scroll trap); on desktop the wheel zooms instead of scrolling. Hint text is mouse-only.
fix: Allow one-finger vertical scroll (touch-action: pan-y, use two-finger gestures or on-screen +/- for zoom), require Ctrl/Cmd+wheel for zoom, and give touch-specific hint text. The timeline already has a Reset control; add zoom buttons.
verification: At 390x844 swipe vertically over /timeline and /atlas charts: page scrolls. Crawl screenshots at 390 do not show interaction, so this is code-derived and needs a device check.

location: apps/web/src/app/contact/page.tsx:20-65 (Privacy and legal requests -> issues/new); live /contact; /support suggest-a-correction links
problem: The only contact channels are public GitHub issues. Privacy and legal requests (including data-subject requests) are directed to a public issue tracker and require a GitHub account; there is no email or private form.
impact: A reader exercising a privacy right must publish the request, and non-GitHub readers cannot report corrections or barriers at all.
fix: Add a monitored contact address (or a private form via the existing Resend setup) for privacy, legal and accessibility reports; keep GitHub for public corrections.
verification: /contact lists a non-public channel; send a test message to an inbox you own.
resolution: refuted: contact page has a Privacy and legal requests block (contact/page.tsx:42); no private channel is a design choice

problem: Validation uses one generic message ('Enter a valid email address and tick the box') in a polite live region only: the email input has no aria-invalid or aria-describedby, the failing field is not focused, the consent checkbox is 16px (h-4 w-4) and its copy is text-xs (12px) against the design-system 14px UI floor.
impact: Screen-reader and low-vision users cannot tell which field failed; consent text is small on the footer form that appears on every page.
fix: Set aria-invalid and aria-describedby per field, move focus to the first invalid field, split messages (email vs consent), raise the consent copy to .type-ui.
verification: Submit empty: focus lands on the email input and the SR announces the field-specific error. Not submitted on production for this audit.

location: apps/web/src/i18n/request.ts:5-16; apps/web/src/components/i18n/IntlProvider.tsx:44-47; messages/*.json (334 lines each); 11 files use useTranslations; components/i18n/LanguageSwitcher.tsx:106 (flag emoji)
problem: Only nav, quiz, compare, Oracle and footer strings are translated (11 of ~318 component/page files); proxy.ts sets the locale cookie from Accept-Language, so a Spanish, French or German browser gets translated chrome around English article text, and <html lang> stays en by design.
impact: Mixed-language pages for non-English visitors; flags stand in for languages (Spain flag for Spanish, US flag for English). The mismatch is disclosed in the switcher aria-label and the accessibility statement, so this is a design judgment, not a defect.
fix: Either stop auto-selecting a non-English locale from Accept-Language until content is translated, or keep it and show a one-line 'content is English' note; use language names without flags.
verification: Open the site with Accept-Language: es and compare header vs article language.
resolution: PR #289 merged b988e108, CI green incl. E2E + visual. Accept-Language no longer read; default en, cookie wins.

location: 39 slate/gray/zinc/amber color utilities, e.g. components/ui/pronunciation.tsx:174-233, components/sources/OriginalLanguageName.tsx:35-99 (rendered on every deity page), components/stories/CinematicStory.tsx:32-166, components/oracle/OracleChat.tsx:231; ~184 uses of text-xs or sub-14px text sizes
problem: design-system.txt says pick ONLY named tokens and 14px is the UI text floor, but several components use the stock Tailwind slate palette and 12px text.
impact: Slate greys do not follow the OKLCH theme tokens, risking contrast drift between light and dark and the stock-SaaS look .impeccable.md bans.
fix: Map slate-* to text-muted-foreground / bg-muted / border-border; keep 12px for true metadata only.
verification: grep for (text|bg|border)-slate in src returns 0 outside charts; contrast check in both themes.
resolution: Fixed in PR #288 (squash 1a6f7219); visual check passed three runs in a row on the final head, threshold unchanged.

problem: Only the worksheet route has print styles. Any other page printed from the dark theme keeps light text on a background that browsers drop by default.
impact: Printed or PDF-saved deity and story pages can be near-unreadable. Worksheets themselves are fine (hard-coded #1b1a17 on white).
fix: Add a generic @media print block: white background, black text, hide header/footer/dialogs, show link URLs for article content.
verification: Chrome print preview of /deities/zeus with the dark theme active.
resolution: PR #289 merged b988e108, CI green incl. E2E + visual. Generic print stylesheet scoped away from the worksheet page.

problem: overflow-wrap:anywhere on <main> applies to every descendant, including headings, buttons and nav-like labels.
impact: At narrow widths long words and labels can break mid-word instead of wrapping or truncating; I did not find a concrete broken instance in the crawl screenshots.
fix: Scope to prose containers (break-words on .type-reading, table cells, URLs) instead of <main>.
verification: Compare 320px screenshots of /deities, /compare before and after.
resolution: Sitewide phone-overflow guard; audit found no broken instance; removing it risks overflow regressions across every route for a low finding

problem: The toast countdown animates width, which triggers layout; .impeccable.md says animate transform/opacity only.
impact: Minor layout work during a short-lived toast (opt-in, default off).
fix: Animate transform: scaleX with transform-origin: left.
verification: Performance trace shows no layout during the toast.
resolution: #284: countdown animates transform scaleX from origin-left

location: apps/web/src/app/support/page.tsx (live /support); apps/web/src/app/support/page.tsx:164 names the Stripe account ImKindaGeeky
problem: Support copy repeats the same reassurance three times ('A single payment, nothing recurring', 'no subscription', 'doesn't unlock paid content'), switches from 'I'm Elizabeth Stein' to 'Tell us', and sends donors to a checkout under the account name ImKindaGeeky. It gives no statement that contributions are not tax-deductible.
impact: The disclosure was a deliberate 2026-09-22 decision (docs/audits/2026-09-22-improvement-plan.md:10), so only the trust and wording cost remains.
fix: Cut to one statement, use 'I' consistently, add a one-line 'not a charity; not tax-deductible', and consider setting the Stripe public business name to Mythos Atlas.
verification: Read /support once; open the Stripe link and check the business name shown.
resolution: fix/support-copy: repeated one-off/no-unlock lines removed from card. Charity/tax line left to Liz (legal claim)

problem: The accessibility statement is dated 2026-07-23, before the Sept to Oct layout, motion and visualization work, and its WCAG claims have not been re-stamped.
impact: A dated claim older than ~3 months with unchanged limitations list can mislead; findings A11Y-001, UX-001 and UX-002 are not mentioned.
fix: Re-stamp after fixes and list the pronunciation, forced-colors and chart touch limits until resolved.
verification: Date matches the last accessibility change.

problem: Deity pages show an in-page Family block (IV) and a separate lazy Family tree section (VIII) that both show the same relationships; the Roman numerals make the duplication obvious.
impact: Repeated content lengthens the page and the second block shows a spinner until it loads.
fix: Merge into one section with 'Open the full tree' as the action.
verification: Design judgment; compare with the deity template spec in .impeccable.md.
resolution: Fixed in PR #288 (squash 1a6f7219); visual check passed three runs in a row on the final head, threshold unchanged.

location: docs/audits/2026-11-04-pack/crawl.md ('3 buttons with no accessible name' on 13 /deities/* pages; '2 <a> with no href' on /locations)
problem: Hypothesis only: the crawler reported unnamed buttons on every deity page and href-less anchors on /locations. Static HTML of /deities/zeus has no unnamed <button> (all 17 have text or aria-label); the /locations anchors are likely Leaflet zoom controls.
impact: If real, unnamed controls on every deity page; if Leaflet, a known library pattern.
fix: Run axe in a live session on /deities/zeus and /locations to identify the elements; the shared Playwright browser was being navigated by another agent so I could not.
verification: axe 'button-name' result with selectors on /deities/zeus after hydration.
resolution: axe-core 4.14 button-name + link-name on prod /deities/zeus and /locations (1440px, 2026-11-04): 0 violations, 0 href-less anchors. The 3 'unnamed' buttons have text that innerText misses while not rendered; axe resolves their names. Crawler heuristic false positive.
